name: hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs
description: Updates notification and email alert preferences for a user at either a kennel level (HasherKennelMap) or event level (HasherEventMap). Requires either @kennelId or @eventId — both null is an error. Creates HKM/HEM records if they don't exist. Returns adHoc data with current pref values after the write, then delegates to hcapp_syncUserData. Note: no authorization check on @hasherId — any authenticated user can change any other user's preferences.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: User whose preferences to update. Defaults to calling user if NULL.

parameters.name: emailPreference
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (don't update). 0 clears the HEM event preference to NULL.

parameters.name: notificationPreference
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. 0 clears the HEM event preference to NULL.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Target kennel. Resolved from @eventId when @eventId is provided.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Target event. When provided, updates HC.HasherEventMap instead of HC.HasherKennelMap.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId or both @kennelId and @eventId null. errorType=3 for auth failure.

columns.name: notificationPreference
columns.description: Current notification preference after the write.

columns.name: emailAlertPreference
columns.description: Current email alert preference after the write.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap — when @eventId is null and no existing HKM record
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — when @eventId is null and HKM record exists
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — when @eventId is provided and no existing HEM record
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap — when @eventId is provided and HEM record exists

codeSmells.issue: No authorization check — any user can change any other user's prefs
codeSmells.detail: @hasherId can be set to any hasher's UUID. There is no check that the calling user is an admin or that @hasherId == @userId. Any authenticated user can change notification settings for any other user.

codeSmells.issue: Asymmetric NULL-clearing behaviour between HKM and HEM
codeSmells.detail: For HKM: emailPreference=0 is stored as-is. For HEM: emailPreference=0 clears the column to NULL (with CASE WHEN ... = 0 THEN NULL). The semantics of 0 differ between the two paths.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
